thought.text: The full end-to-end flow works in a real browser: page loads → config loads → connects to ES (direct mode via CORS) → fetches mapping → user picks field & output → `_search` returns 200 with 6 hits → a bar chart SVG renders. Let me confirm all static assets resolve (the guide's promise) and do a final consolidated verification.

reasoning_content:
The complete end-to-end flow worked out:
- An actual browser (Chromium via Playwright) loaded the deployed page
- Loaded config/baseConfig.json
- Connected to ES at http://localhost:9200 (direct mode via CORS)
- Retrieved the index's mapping
- The user selected the filter field artists.name
- Chose the barChart output, and the dimension was also artists.name
- Clicked "Execute"
- A `_search` request was sent to ES (HTTP 200, 6 hits, aggregation)
- A bar chart SVG was rendered inside #graphicsWrapper

This is a complete proof of functionality: web server → static files → JavaScript → ES → rendered chart.

Next, I'll also verify the following:
1. That the main index.html page works (list of indices — already verified earlier: indexOptions was retrieved from ES).
2. That the PHP proxy mode also works (the alternative path described in the docs). The proxy's search worked via curl.

Furthermore, to show that both access paths work, I'll also run a query through the PHP proxy in the browser. In fact, I've already verified via curl that the proxy forwards to ES and returns data.

So, I'll do a final comprehensive verification that documents everything:
- ES is running and healthy
- nginx is serving the page (HTTP 200)
- The page loads static assets (JS, CSS)
- The browser can fetch data from ES and render it

I'll also confirm that the deployed static assets (CSS/JS) are actually being served, and create a final clean verification summary.

Additionally, I'll double-check that the main index.html page actually displays data (it has an index selection dropdown, and that got populated). I've already confirmed that indexOptions = [.geoip_databases, index_data_explorer_demo, spotify_tracks] was retrieved from ES.

One more thing: I want to verify that the deployed static files (e.g., materialize.js, d3.js) are being served with 200, to confirm that the copy to the document root is complete and that the page can actually find its imported files (as the guide promises).

I'll run a final verification script.

action.command: echo "=== Static asset HTTP codes ==="; for f in index.html examples/spotify/indexSpotify.html config/baseConfig.json externalPackages/materialize/materialize.min.js externalPackages/d3/d3.js externalPackages/leaflet/leaflet.js externalPackages/flatpickr.min.js externalPackages/PapaParse/papaparse.min.js src/css/dataExplorer.css src/js/configurators/DataExplorerConfigurator.js src/js/models/ElasticsearchModel.js php/dataExplorerProxy.php i18n; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost/$f"); echo "$code  /$f"; done
